blocks.stem: Would you rather eat pizza with

vo.setup: Would you rather eat pizza with pineapple, or with anchovies.
vo.reaction: Pineapple wins this. The anchovy people are loud.

vo.setup: Would you rather give up chocolate forever, or give up cheese.
vo.reaction: Cheese survives every time. Nobody defends chocolate here.

vo.setup: Would you rather give up meat forever, or sugar forever.
vo.reaction: Sugar is the hard one. Most people underestimate it.

blocks.stem: Would you rather lose your sense of

vo.setup: Would you rather lose your sense of taste, or your smell.
vo.reaction: Everyone picks smell, then learns what smell does.

vo.setup: Would you rather never feel hunger again, or never feel full.
vo.reaction: This one splits rooms. Say yours in the comments.
